title: Reading Practice Test 20 – Corporate Strategy
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: thông báo bổ nhiệm, thư gửi cổ đông, bài báo có chèn câu, ba đoạn liên kết). Chủ đề: chiến lược, mua lại, mở rộng thị trường quốc tế.

questions.content: The board of directors approved the merger ------- a two-hour meeting.
questions.explanation: 'after + cụm danh từ' = sau (cuộc họp hai tiếng). 'while/unless' cần mệnh đề; 'since' không hợp với quá khứ đơn.

questions.content: The company's profits have grown ------- over the past five years.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'have grown' → trạng từ 'consistently' (đều đặn).

questions.content: ------- the merger is completed, the combined company will have 12,000 employees.
questions.explanation: Theo sau là mệnh đề → liên từ 'Once' (một khi). Các lựa chọn khác là giới từ.

questions.content: The CEO confirmed that the company ------- two new factories in Vietnam next year.
questions.explanation: 'next year' → hành động trong tương lai 'will open'.

questions.content: The strategic plan focuses on ------- customer loyalty and reducing costs.
questions.explanation: 'focus on + V-ing', song song với 'reducing' → 'improving'.

questions.content: The two companies signed an agreement to share ------- research facilities.
questions.explanation: Tính từ sở hữu đứng trước cụm danh từ 'research facilities' → 'their'.

questions.content: The new branch in Singapore will serve as the company's ------- headquarters.
questions.explanation: Tính từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ 'headquarters' → 'regional headquarters' (trụ sở khu vực).

questions.content: ------- market conditions improve, the company plans to hire 200 new employees.
questions.explanation: 'Provided that' = miễn là, với điều kiện là (+ mệnh đề). Các lựa chọn khác đi với danh từ hoặc sai nghĩa.

questions.content: The consultant's report contains several recommendations, ------- of which have already been implemented.
questions.explanation: 'some of which' = một vài trong số đó (thay cho recommendations số nhiều, động từ 'have').

questions.content: The company has become a leader in renewable energy ------- its early investments in solar technology.
questions.explanation: 'thanks to' = nhờ vào (nguyên nhân tích cực).

groups.passage:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Vantage Foods to Acquire GreenLeaf Organics

DENVER, March 12 – Vantage Foods announced today that it has reached an agreement to acquire GreenLeaf Organics, a leading producer of organic snacks, for $85 million. The deal is expected ---131--- by the end of June.

GreenLeaf's products, which include granola bars and dried fruit, are sold in more than 3,000 stores nationwide. ---132---.

"This acquisition will allow us to meet the growing ---133--- for healthy snacks," said Vantage CEO Martin Cole. GreenLeaf will continue to operate under its own brand name, and its headquarters will remain in Boulder.

---134---, all 150 GreenLeaf employees will keep their current positions.

questions.explanation: 'be expected + to V' = được dự kiến sẽ… → 'to close' (hoàn tất thương vụ).

options.A: The company was founded by two college friends in 2012.
options.B: Denver is known for its mountains.
options.D: Snacks should be stored in a cool place.

questions.explanation: Đoạn đang giới thiệu GreenLeaf → câu chèn bổ sung thông tin về lịch sử thành lập công ty này.
Sau 'the growing' cần danh từ: 'meet the growing demand for' = đáp ứng nhu cầu ngày càng tăng về.
Câu sau bổ sung thêm cam kết (giữ toàn bộ nhân viên) sau các cam kết giữ thương hiệu và trụ sở → 'In addition'.

groups.passage:
Company News – April 2

We are pleased to announce that Linda Park has been appointed Vice President of International Sales, effective May 1. Ms. Park joined the company twelve years ago as a sales representative in our Seoul office and most recently served as Director of Asia-Pacific Sales. In her new role, she will oversee our sales teams in 14 countries.

Please join us in congratulating Linda!

questions.content: What is the purpose of the announcement?

options.C: To report a change in someone's position

questions.explanation: Thông báo bà Linda Park được bổ nhiệm làm Phó chủ tịch kinh doanh quốc tế → thay đổi chức vụ.

questions.content: What is indicated about Ms. Park?

options.A: She began working for the company in Seoul.
options.C: She was hired twelve months ago.
options.D: She will move to the Seoul office.

questions.explanation: 'Ms. Park joined the company twelve years ago as a sales representative in our Seoul office.' (C) nhầm năm thành tháng.

groups.passage:
Dear Shareholders,

I am pleased to report that Orion Electronics had a record year. Revenue rose 18 percent to $2.4 billion, driven mainly by strong sales of our smart home devices.

This year, we will focus on three goals. First, we plan to enter the Latin American market by opening offices in Mexico City and São Paulo. Second, we will increase our investment in research and development by 25 percent. Finally, we aim to reduce our carbon emissions by 30 percent by the end of the decade.

Our annual shareholders' meeting will be held on May 15 in Chicago. Details are included in the enclosed booklet.

Sincerely,
Rebecca Stone
Chief Executive Officer

questions.content: What contributed most to the increase in revenue?
questions.explanation: '…driven mainly by strong sales of our smart home devices.'

questions.content: What is NOT mentioned as a goal for this year?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi NOT: ba mục tiêu là thị trường Mỹ Latinh, tăng đầu tư R&D, giảm khí thải – không nhắc tới tuyển thêm nhân viên.

questions.content: What is enclosed with the letter?
questions.explanation: 'Details are included in the enclosed booklet' – thông tin về đại hội cổ đông ngày 15/5.

groups.passage:
Companies Rethink the Office
By Daniel Kim

As more employees split their time between home and the office, many companies are rethinking how much office space they need. [1] A recent survey of 400 large firms found that nearly half plan to reduce their office space over the next three years.

Rather than simply giving up space, some companies are redesigning their offices to encourage collaboration. [2] Private desks are being replaced with meeting rooms, lounges, and project areas where teams can work together on the days they come in.

Tech firm Nexora, for example, cut its office space in half last year but invested the savings in employee training and new equipment for home offices. [3] "Our people come to the office to connect, not to answer e-mails," said Nexora's CEO. [4]

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?

options.D: Changes in how companies use office space

questions.explanation: Bài viết về việc doanh nghiệp thu hẹp và thiết kế lại văn phòng khi nhân viên làm việc kết hợp.

questions.content: What is Nexora mentioned as an example of?

options.A: A company that is hiring rapidly
options.B: A company that opened new offices
options.C: A company that used savings from a smaller office in other ways
options.D: A company that stopped allowing remote work

questions.explanation: Nexora giảm một nửa diện tích văn phòng và dùng khoản tiết kiệm cho đào tạo và thiết bị làm việc tại nhà.

questions.content: The word "split" in paragraph 1, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'split their time between home and the office' = chia thời gian giữa nhà và văn phòng → divide.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Many employees now work from the office only two or three days a week."
questions.explanation: Câu chèn giải thích cụ thể việc nhân viên chia thời gian giữa nhà và văn phòng ở câu đầu → vị trí [1].

groups.passage:
Market Research Summary – Expansion Options for Bloom Coffee
Prepared by Meridian Consulting

Lisbon – Population 545,000 – 9 coffee shops per 10,000 residents – Average rent $28 per sq. m
Porto – Population 232,000 – 6 coffee shops per 10,000 residents – Average rent $19 per sq. m
Valencia – Population 790,000 – 11 coffee shops per 10,000 residents – Average rent $24 per sq. m
Seville – Population 685,000 – 7 coffee shops per 10,000 residents – Average rent $21 per sq. m

Recommendation: Enter the market with the fewest coffee shops per resident, where competition will be lowest.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: Expansion Team
From: Carla Ruiz, CEO
Date: September 4
Subject: Expansion decision

Team,

Thank you for reviewing Meridian's research. After our discussion, the board has decided to follow the consultant's recommendation for our first international location. However, we also want to open a second store within a year in whichever of the remaining cities has the lowest rent.

Tomás will lead the first project. Please begin searching for store locations and report back by October 15.

Carla

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Expansion Team Meeting – October 16
1. Report on store locations in the first city – Tomás Vidal
2. Hiring plan for the first store – Ana Costa
3. Preliminary research for the second store – Joel Martin
4. Budget review – Carla Ruiz

questions.content: What is the purpose of the research summary?

options.B: To compare cities for a possible expansion

questions.explanation: Bản tóm tắt so sánh 4 thành phố để chọn nơi mở rộng kinh doanh.

questions.content: In which city will Bloom Coffee most likely open its first international store?
questions.explanation: Hội đồng theo khuyến nghị: chọn nơi có ít quán cà phê nhất trên số dân → Porto (6/10.000).

questions.content: In which city will the second store most likely open?
questions.explanation: Trong các thành phố còn lại (Lisbon $28, Valencia $24, Seville $21), giá thuê thấp nhất là Seville.

questions.content: What will Tomás Vidal most likely discuss at the October 16 meeting?
questions.explanation: Tomás phụ trách dự án đầu tiên (Porto) và báo cáo địa điểm cửa hàng ở thành phố đầu tiên (mục 1 chương trình họp).

questions.content: Who will most likely present information about Seville?
questions.explanation: Seville là thành phố cho cửa hàng thứ hai; mục 3 'Preliminary research for the second store' do Joel Martin trình bày.
